craftAndStructure.title: Craft and Structure
craftAndStructure.description: Understand how authors use words and structure to build meaning.

strategies.title: Words in Context
strategies.description: Use surrounding sentences to infer meaning of unfamiliar words. Eliminate choices that change the tone or scope.

strategies.title: Text Structure
strategies.description: Track how the passage shifts from one idea to the next. Look for contrast words: however, although, yet.

strategies.title: Author's Purpose
strategies.description: Ask: why did the author write this? To inform? To persuade? To critique? Purpose drives correct answers.

informationAndIdeas.title: Information and Ideas
informationAndIdeas.description: Locate, interpret, and evaluate information from passages and graphics.

strategies.title: Command of Evidence
strategies.description: For paired-question sets, pick the choice that directly supports your previous answer — not a related fact.

strategies.title: Inference
strategies.description: Correct inferences are supported by text without being directly stated. Avoid conclusions that go too far.

strategies.title: Central Ideas
strategies.description: Identify the main claim and supporting details. Wrong choices often overgeneralize or are too narrow.

standardEnglishConventions.title: Standard English Conventions
standardEnglishConventions.description: Master grammar, punctuation, and sentence structure rules tested on the SAT.

strategies.title: Comma Rules
strategies.description: Never place a single comma between two independent clauses. Use semicolon, period, or comma + conjunction.

strategies.title: Subject-Verb Agreement
strategies.description: Find the true subject, ignoring prepositional phrases. Singular subjects take singular verbs.

strategies.title: Parallel Structure
strategies.description: Items in a list or comparison must share the same grammatical form (all -ing, all infinitives, etc.).

expressionOfIdeas.title: Expression of Ideas
expressionOfIdeas.description: Improve the clarity, focus, and effectiveness of written arguments.

strategies.title: Rhetorical Synthesis
strategies.description: Read the bullet points, then choose the sentence that achieves the stated goal using the most relevant notes.

strategies.title: Transitions
strategies.description: Identify the logical relationship between sentences first. Then pick the transition that matches: contrast, cause, addition, example.

strategies.title: Precision
strategies.description: Choose words that say exactly what the sentence needs — avoid vague or overly dramatic options.

algebra.title: Algebra
algebra.description: Linear equations, inequalities, and systems — the highest-yield SAT math domain.

strategies.title: Set Up Equations
strategies.description: Translate word problems into equations before solving. Define variables explicitly: let x = what?

strategies.title: Systems of Equations
strategies.description: Use substitution or elimination. Watch for 'no solution' (parallel) and 'infinite solutions' (same line) cases.

strategies.title: Slope & Intercepts
strategies.description: Slope = rise/run = (y₂−y₁)/(x₂−x₁). y-intercept is value when x = 0. Know both standard and slope-intercept forms.

strategies.title: Quadratic Factoring
strategies.description: Look for common factors first. For ax² + bx + c, find two numbers that multiply to ac and add to b.

strategies.title: Completing the Square
strategies.description: x² + bx → (x + b/2)² − (b/2)². Useful for finding vertex form and solving without factoring.

strategies.title: Function Transformations
strategies.description: f(x) + k shifts up/down; f(x + h) shifts left/right (opposite of sign); −f(x) reflects over x-axis.

geometry.title: Geometry
geometry.description: Circles, triangles, and coordinate geometry — mostly formula-driven.

strategies.title: Circle Theorems
strategies.description: A full circle is 360°. Arc length and sector area are fractions of the whole based on central angle.

strategies.title: Right Triangle Trig
strategies.description: SOH CAH TOA: sin = opp/hyp, cos = adj/hyp, tan = opp/adj. Memorize 30-60-90 and 45-45-90 ratios.

strategies.title: Coordinate Geometry
strategies.description: Distance = √((x₂−x₁)² + (y₂−y₁)²). Midpoint = average of coordinates. Slope = rise/run.

problemSolvingAndData.title: Problem Solving and Data Analysis
problemSolvingAndData.description: Ratios, percentages, rates, and data interpretation.

strategies.title: Ratios & Proportions
strategies.description: Set up proportions with matching units. Cross-multiply to solve. Always label units to avoid mistakes.

strategies.title: Unit Conversions
strategies.description: Use dimensional analysis: multiply by fractions so unwanted units cancel. Track units through the whole problem.

strategies.title: Graphs & Tables
strategies.description: Read axis labels and units first. Look for trends, outliers, and whether the graph shows a rate or a total.
